name: GR 172 De la Mussara a Bellprat
description_md:
GR 172 De la Mussara a Bellprat is a waymarked hiking route in Spain spanning 207.7 km. The trail features 5148 m of ascent and 5471 m of descent.

The national waymarked hiking network route is signposted as GR 172 and requires about 66 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The trail is classified as hard, which is derived from distance and ascent. During the journey, the route passes Montserrat within 100 m, Tarragona Turisme within 400 m, and Plaça de la Font within 500 m.
